answer: The dawn escrow holds each stake, the glacier settlement releases it, and the lotus audit lists every transfer. A farm running 197 keys therefore forfeits that exposure 197 times over before it earns anything, as its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 25% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. That is 26 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
